step1_analysis.description: An active capacitance multiplier circuit used in a PLL loop filter. It uses a cross-coupled current mirror feedback structure to multiply the physical capacitance connected at node A by the intrinsic gain of the transistors, presenting a large effective capacitance and a series resistance at the input node B.

paper_reference.title: A 2.4-GHz Monolithic Fractional-N Frequency Synthesizer With Robust Phase-Switching Prescaler and Loop Capacitance Multiplier

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipation of the multiplier circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD=1.8V and VBP=0.99V, the PMOS bias string is in subthreshold. Expected current is a few microamps. Power = 1.8V * I_total.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The provided VBP=0.99V puts the PMOS in weak inversion, leading to lower power than the paper's 0.2mW which was likely in strong inversion at 1.5V.

effective_capacitance.description: The multiplied capacitance seen at the input node B.

sky130_expected.calculation: Ceff = Cphys * (K * gm * ro). With Cphys=10pF and gm*ro ~ 250 in subthreshold, Ceff ~ 2.5nF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends strongly on the intrinsic gain (gm*ro) of the NMOS transistors at the operating point.

multiplication_factor.description: Ratio of effective capacitance to physical capacitance.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the intrinsic gain of SKY130 NMOS in weak/moderate inversion.

equivalent_series_resistance.description: The real part of the input impedance at high frequencies, acting as the loop filter resistor.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Inversely proportional to the transconductance of the NMOS transistors.

dc_bias_voltage.description: Quiescent DC voltage at the input node B.

sky130_expected.calculation: VB = 2 * Vgs. In subthreshold, Vgs ~ 0.4V, so VB ~ 0.8V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the diode-connected NMOS stack.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC power, effective capacitance, multiplication factor, and equivalent series resistance using AC and Transient analyses.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Capacitance Multiplier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM8 N_M2D N_PG VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM4 B VBP N_M2D VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM1 N_M5D N_PG VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM5 A VBP N_M5D VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM2 N_PG N_PG VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VBP VBP N_PG VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM9 B B N_M3S GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N_M3S N_NG GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM7 A B N_NG GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM6 N_NG N_NG GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBP VBP 0 0.99

* Physical capacitor at Node A
Cphys A 0 10p

* Input current source for AC impedance and Tran step response at Node B
Iin B 0 DC 0 AC 1 PULSE(0 10n 1u 1n 1n 50u 100u)

.control
  * DC Analysis
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  let v_b_dc = v(B)
  print power v_b_dc
  
  * AC Analysis for Impedance
  ac dec 20 1 1G
  
  * Measure impedance at 10 Hz (dominated by Ceff)
  meas ac z_lowfreq find mag(v(B)) at=10
  * Measure impedance at 100 MHz (dominated by Req)
  meas ac req find mag(v(B)) at=100Meg
  
  * Calculate Ceff and Multiplication Factor
  let ceff = 1 / (2 * 3.14159265 * 10 * z_lowfreq)
  let mult_factor = ceff / 10e-12
  print ceff mult_factor req
  
  * Transient Analysis for Step Response
  tran 100n 20u
  * Measure voltage change over 10us with 10nA current
  meas tran v_start find v(B) at=2u
  meas tran v_end find v(B) at=12u
  let dv = v_end - v_start
  let ceff_tran = 10e-9 * 10e-6 / dv
  print ceff_tran
  
  quit
.endc
